name: neoarchivist
description: Keeps a project's Obsidian vault behind one agent, neoarchivist:agent, so the main conversation's context stays free: Claude sends it JSON requests to look things up or record work, checked by hooks against a contract. The vault keeps notes on what is true now, a daily memo of what happened with plain follow-up checkboxes, and a decision note for each choice worth explaining. Commands: init, ask, record, todos, lint, graph and preset. Requires kepano/obsidian-skills.
